title: Staying in school
summary: A secondary-school student in Dhading was at risk of interrupting her studies because of education-related costs. After the need was verified through her school, Aashirbad helped cover essential expenses so she could continue the academic year. Her headteacher confirmed her enrollment the following term.

image.alt: A school community gathering at a partner school in Dhading, Nepal

title: Seeing more options
summary: For many students, the challenge is not only paying for school. It is also knowing what can come next. Through regular mentor conversations, students ask practical questions about higher education, different fields of work, and the steps needed to get there. Mentors check in weekly and help students set goals they can act on.

image.alt: Students and mentors gathered together at a school in Dhading, Nepal

title: First time using a computer
summary: At a partner school in Dhading, some students had very limited opportunities to use a computer outside the classroom. Shared devices and guided sessions gave them a chance to practice basic digital skills, explore educational content, and become more comfortable using technology. The goal is earlier exposure, not a device for each student.

image.alt: Students using shared computers in a classroom supported by Aashirbad Foundation
